criteria.name: Final timing label
criteria.description: Gives wind_pressure_then_rain_same_day and rejects same-hour and rain-first summaries.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a near-equivalent phrase with the correct order but no exact label.

criteria.name: Event anchors
criteria.description: Reports 2022-09-23 to 2022-09-30, United States and Cuba, Red alert, and 249.9984 km/h severity.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for at least two correct anchors.

criteria.name: Wind-pressure extrema
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for two correct extrema or correct values with incomplete timestamps.

criteria.name: Rainfall ledger
criteria.description: Reports 211.5 mm total, 14.4 mm at 2022-09-28T22:00, 146.0 mm on 2022-09-28, and 69.0% peak-day share.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correct rainfall values without the share, or the share with one minor value error.

criteria.name: Timing and daily rainfall concentration
criteria.description: Gives lag hours 1, 1, 4, and 3, reports the 69.0% peak-day share, and shows the peak daily rainfall occurs on the wind-pressure peak date.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct lags without the daily concentration check, or the concentration check without all lags.

criteria.name: Compact answer discipline
criteria.description: Uses units, timestamps, the requested structured fields, and one concise sentence tying the label to the calculations.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct result with missing units, loose formatting, or extra narrative that does not change the answer.
